title: Event-Native Symbolic-Temporal Spike Encoding Framework for Heterogeneous Cyber Streams
abstract: arXiv:2609.15772v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) have shown promise for sparse, event-driven computation through stateful processing that is naturally compatible with low-power edge hardware. These properties align with cyber monitoring, where data arrives asynchronously, and malicious behavior often emerges through temporal patterns across event sequences. However, cyber streams are not composed solely of continuous numeric signals: their informative structure is also carried by categorical identifiers, irregular timing, and local behavioral context. Traditional rate- and population-based spike encodings are not naturally suited to these heterogeneous semantics, while conventional intrusion detection system (IDS) pipelines typically resolve the mismatch by converting raw events into flows, fixed aggregation windows, or dense tensors. translated_title: 面向异构网络数据流的事件原生符号-时间脉冲编码框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.15772v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：脉冲神经网络（SNN）在稀疏、事件驱动的计算方面展现出前景，其具有状态的处理方式天然兼容低功耗边缘硬件。这些特性与网络监控需求高度契合——在网络监控场景中，数据以异步方式到达，而恶意行为往往通过事件序列中的时间模式显现。然而，网络数据流并非仅由连续的数值信号构成：其信息结构还承载于类别标识符、不规则时间戳以及局部行为上下文之中。传统的基于速率和基于群体神经的脉冲编码方式并不天然适合这些异构语义，而传统入侵检测系统（IDS）流程通常通过将原始事件转换为流记录、固定聚合窗口或稠密张量来化解这种不匹配。尽管这些转换对传统分类器有效，但它们引入了缓冲延迟，并掩盖了数据原生的时间信息……
tldr: 提出了一种面向异构网络数据流的事件原生符号-时间脉冲编码框架，可直接对类别标识符、不规则时间戳等异构语义进行脉冲编码，从而避免传统IDS将原始事件转换为流记录或稠密张量所引入的缓冲延迟与原生时间信息丢失。
en_tdlr: Proposes an event-native symbolic-temporal spike encoding framework for heterogeneous cyber streams that directly encodes categorical identifiers and irregular timing into spikes, avoiding the buffering latency and loss of native temporal information introduced by conventional IDS event-to-flow or dense-tensor transformations.
